add.name: find-animation-opportunities
add.purpose: Read-only sweep of a codebase/UI for places that should animate (and those that should not), proposing motion with exact durations, curves and properties.
add.how_to_use: Ask 'what could be animated here?' or 'make this feel more alive'; pairs with animate/improve-animations from the same pack.
add.evidence: Emil Kowalski pack; skills.sh ~152K installs (higher than animate, already listed).

add.name: gsap-plugins
add.purpose: Official GSAP guide to plugins: registration, Flip, Draggable/Inertia, Observer, ScrollSmoother/ScrollTo, SplitText/ScrambleText, DrawSVG/MorphSVG/MotionPath, CustomEase family, GSDevTools.
add.how_to_use: Triggers when using any GSAP plugin; `npx skills add greensock/gsap-skills`.
add.evidence: Official GreenSock; skills.sh ~56K installs; largest skill in the pack (~21KB).

add.name: gsap-react
add.purpose: Official GSAP patterns for React/Next.js: useGSAP hook, refs, gsap.context() scoping, cleanup on unmount, SSR pitfalls.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on GSAP in React/Next.js; `npx skills add greensock/gsap-skills`.

add.name: gsap-timeline
add.purpose: Official GSAP timeline skill: gsap.timeline(), position parameter, nesting, labels and playback control for choreographed multi-step sequences.

add.name: figma-implement-motion
add.purpose: Translates Figma motion/animation data (via the Figma MCP get_motion_context) into production animation code.
add.how_to_use: Use with the Figma MCP server when a Figma node is animated or the user says 'implement this motion'.
add.notes: Repo has no license file -> link-only. Requires Figma MCP server.

add.name: scroll-scrubbed-visual-sequence
add.purpose: Builds reversible scroll-controlled visual sequences with a pinned/sticky stage and normalized progress, rendering via video, image sequence, canvas, SVG or DOM.
add.how_to_use: Use for scroll-scrubbed hero films, product assembly or photo sequences that play forward/back with native scroll; has REFERENCES.md and a demo.
add.evidence: Meng To (Design+Code) skills repo, 6.6k stars; the generic public counterpart of a scroll-scrubbed cinematic hero.
add.notes: mengto/skills was in sources_checked but none of its skills were listed.

add.name: cinematic-scroll-storytelling
add.purpose: Cinematic scroll-driven landing pages with Lenis + GSAP ScrollTrigger: staggered text reveals, sticky card stacks, parallax, scroll-scrubbed transitions, preloaders.
add.how_to_use: Use when building or analysing premium editorial scroll experiences.
